exercises.question: Which sentence correctly uses necessity + subjunctive? [¿Cuál usa correctamente necesidad + subjuntivo?]
options: Es necesario que reduzcamos el consumo de agua. [It is necessary that we reduce water consumption.]
Es necesario que reducimos el consumo de agua. [It is necessary that we reduce water consumption.]
Es necesario reduciríamos el consumo de agua. [It is necessary that we would reduce water consumption.]

exercises.sentence: Es importante que __ más. (reciclar) [It is important that we recycle more.]

exercises.english: We need to protect the species.

sentences: Es necesario que reduzcamos el consumo de agua. [It is necessary that we reduce water consumption.]
Es importante que reciclemos más. [It is important that we recycle more.]
Hace falta que protejamos las especies. [We need to protect the species.]

exercises.question: Which form follows «Es importante que»? [¿Qué forma sigue a «Es importante que»?]
options: reciclemos [we recycle]
reciclamos [we recycle]
reciclar [to recycle]

exercises.sentence: Es necesario que __ el consumo. (reducir) [It is necessary that we reduce consumption.]

exercises.english: It is necessary that the city improve public transport.

template.prompt: Give two environmental actions using necessity + subjunctive.
template.answer: Es necesario que reciclemos más y que reduzcamos el consumo de agua.

template.prompt: Say what a city needs to change.
template.answer: Es importante que la ciudad mejore el transporte público y proteja las especies.
